Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the CRM Marketing Executive position at Magic Betting. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your marketing team and grow within a dynamic industry.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my attention to detail and ability to work with various digital tools. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO audits, demonstrating my proactive approach to learning and applying new skills.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and currently improving. My computer skills are excellent, and I have a keen eye for detail, which I believe are essential for building customer journeys and producing HTML email templates. I am eager to receive training and mentorship to excel in this role and contribute to Magic Betting's success.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the CRM Marketing Executive position at Magic Betting. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and a passion for learning, I am confident that I can contribute to your team and grow within this role.

In my current position as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site management. I am responsible for keyword research, writing blog content, and tracking performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. This has sharpened my analytical skills and attention to detail, which are crucial for segmentation, reporting, and KPI tracking in CRM marketing.

I have also developed mirook.com, a personal project where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and conducted technical SEO audits. This project demonstrates my ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and apply technical skills to improve online visibility. I am comfortable with HTML and have basic design skills using Canva, which will be beneficial for creating email templates and landing pages.

I am a quick learner and eager to receive training in CRM tools and customer journey building. My language skills include professional English, native Turkish, and a B1 level in Dutch, which I am actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available to start immediately.

I am excited about the opportunity to join Magic Betting and contribute to your marketing efforts. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
